name: Alarielle the Radiant
canonNotes: The Everqueen of Ulthuan, Isha's chosen priestess, whose presence makes the land bloom and repels corruption.
Rules Avelorn; the eleventh Everqueen since Aenarion.
voiceNotes: Gracious, serene and luminous; speaks of life, nature and healing.
Gentle to friends, unyielding against corruption and the Druchii.
sources: Total War: WARHAMMER III, in-game unit lore (summarised, not quoted)
